direction: Editorial Fashion House — Warm Cream/Ink Palette with Serif Display Headlines, Asymmetric Magazine Layouts, and Soft Glassmorphism

typesetting_rules.eyebrow_and_labels: font-mono uppercase text-xs tracking-[0.2em] font-semibold text-[#825E28]

entry_surfaces./: asymmetric editorial magazine hero with featured look split, warm cream canvas, serif display typography, and real catalog showcase
entry_surfaces./style-studio: atelier studio workbench with clean 3-mode model onboarding panel, high-contrast try-on preview, minimalist outfit slots, and glassmorphic AI style assistant
entry_surfaces./category/[slug]: editorial runway lookbook grid with 1px hairlines, filter drawer, and quick-add to studio slots
entry_surfaces./product/[id]: dual-column fashion house product placard with generous negative space, Indian Rupee pricing, and direct 'Try in Studio' CTA
entry_surfaces./search: refined archive search catalog with minimalist query bar and filtered fashion results
entry_surfaces./cart: chic shopping bag ledger with warm card surfaces, clear order breakdown, and seamless checkout affordance

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous luxury spacing (2-3x typical layouts), sharp 0px to subtle 8px border radii, hairline borders (border-[#E5DFD5]), and strong editorial asymmetry

grid_modes.home_hero: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 lg:gap-12 items-center
grid_modes.studio_workspace: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8 items-start
grid_modes.product_catalog: grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 lg:gap-8

spacing_and_layout.hairline_protocol: Use 1px border lines (#E5DFD5 / #EFECE6) with border-collapse feel rather than heavy drop shadows
spacing_and_layout.container_padding: Generous internal padding: p-6 to p-10 on cards and panels to prevent text collisions

motion.principles: Subtle, weighted, high-fashion motion (no frantic tech bounciness)
motion.hover_states: Hover lift: -translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300 ease-out with shadow-[0_12px_24px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)]
motion.reveals: Gentle opacity and vertical drift (y: 12 -> 0) with staggered delays for product lookbooks
motion.loading_shimmer: Warm cream shimmer skeleton: animate-pulse bg-gradient-to-r from-[#F0EAE1] via-[#E8DFD3] to-[#F0EAE1]

glassmorphism.header_nav: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-[#FAF7F2]/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-[#E5DFD5]

editorial_models.description: Editorial model in tailored blazer and trousers in warm studio lighting
editorial_models.usage: Style Studio hero look preview or main campaign banner

Monochrome high-fashion silhouette in structured white ensemble

brand_header.style: Cream background (#FAF7F2/90) with clean 1px bottom border, serif wordmark 'STYLE ORACLE', monospace navigation tags, and minimalist cart icon with dark pill badge

buttons.primary: bg-[#121212] text-[#FAF7F2] hover:bg-[#2A2825] active:scale-[0.99] font-medium tracking-wide rounded-none sm:rounded-md transition-all px-7 py-3
buttons.outline: border border-[#121212] text-[#121212] bg-transparent hover:bg-[#121212] hover:text-[#FAF7F2] font-medium rounded-none sm:rounded-md transition-all px-7 py-3
buttons.editorial_gold: bg-[#9E7238] text-white hover:bg-[#855E2B] font-medium rounded-none sm:rounded-md

style_studio_redesign.onboarding: Replace purple gradient with cream (#FAF7F2) studio background, sharp bespoke option cards with warm gold active borders, and clear photo upload placards
style_studio_redesign.model_workspace: Left model canvas framed like a Vogue editorial proof sheet with aspect-[3/4], subtle cream grain background, and chic download action
style_studio_redesign.outfit_slots: Middle column formatted as atelier garment tickets with product thumbnails, clear Indian Rupee (₹) pricing, and '+' slot triggers with gold accents
style_studio_redesign.chat_sidebar: Right chat panel restyled into a personal editorial stylist with ink header (#121212), gold tag accents, and crisp product card previews

product_cards.style: Aspect-[3/4] clean image container, subtle zoom on hover, minimal serif title, monospace Indian Rupee price (₹), and clean quick-add affordance

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace all violet/purple color utilities (e.g., bg-violet-*, text-violet-*, border-violet-*, bg-purple-*) with the new editorial warm cream/ink palette (#FAF7F2 for canvas, #121212 for ink/text, #9E7238 / #B88E52 for warm antique gold accents).
2. Update globals.css to import Google fonts Playfair Display (for headings) and Instrument Sans (for body), setting --font-heading to Playfair Display and --font-sans to Instrument Sans.

3. Keep all existing interactive features intact: onboarding step, selfie upload, avatar generation, preset model, 5 outfit slot assignments, Gemini try-on API call, chat query with product injection, and editorial look generation modal.
4. Ensure Indian Rupee (₹) currency formatting is consistently styled across all products, slots, and cart entries.
5. Every interactive element (buttons, upload inputs, slot pickers, chat send, tab switches, cart triggers) must retain or include a clear data-testid attribute for testing.

accessibility.contrast_compliance: All body copy reaches at least 4.5:1 against respective surface backgrounds (#121212 on #FAF7F2 is 16.5:1; #5C5852 on #FAF7F2 is 5.8:1; #FAF7F2 on #121212 is 16.5:1).
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus ring: focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#121212] focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-none
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44x44px touch targets on mobile viewports for all buttons, slots, and interactive pills.
